guardrails: WKQA1 is direct for its own station, but remains a proxy for open-bay Montrose/Fairhope/Point Clear bottom conditions.
NGOFS2 is MODEL guidance and must never be labeled an observation.
NCEI/GRIIDC CTD and mooring values are DIRECT only at their documented locations, depths and times; spatial transfer requires an explicit model/proxy designation.
A discovered dataset or archive endpoint is not an ingested source. Only records with a successful parser, immutable raw hash and normalized rows count as ingested.
Do not promote a shoreline-current, shelf-oxygen or historical-profile predictor until leakage-safe held-out incremental value is demonstrated.
